provenance.scope: Static native branches; no game execution or runtime XLua verification.

result.scope: Ordinary native entry, Buff installation/enabling and owner-born paths. This does not identify every content binding or prescribe one common entry callback. External hotfix/error edges remain explicit; selected .pdata ranges do not exhaust a lifecycle.
